errors.text_span: Der Wertebereich der x-Achse ist von 1991 bis 2019.
errors.evidence: This sentence is redundant because the range of the x-axis was already defined in the preceding sentence.
The line plot does not have any markers; it is a solid line.
The description uses a period as a decimal separator, whereas the chart's y-axis labels use a comma (e.g., "0,25"), which is standard for the German language used in the description.

The x-axis tick labels are for odd-numbered years (1991, 1993, 1995, etc.). There is no data point for the year 1994. The description repeatedly hallucinates data points for even-numbered years that are not plotted (1994, 2002, 2008, 2014).
The data point for 1997 is visibly below the 0.25 gridline, at approximately 0.245. The reported value of 0.257 is incorrect.
The value for 2019 is just below the 0.30 gridline, at approximately 0.295. The reported value of 0.289 is visibly too low.
The description does not mention the direct label "Gini-Koeffizient" that identifies the blue line on the chart.
